The campus budget risk calculator achieved a perfect reward score by passing all legacy pytest suites without exceptions.
The execution completed with a verifier_reward of 1.00 and zero exceptions across all trials. Pytest version 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with a duration of 0.36s. While the judge_reward of 0.71 suggests potential for optimization in code quality or edge-case handling, the core logic successfully met all functional requirements defined in the test suite.
